android.desc:
Memio is more than just a note-taking app; it is your personal knowledge hub. Memio is dedicated to transforming fragmented information into a systematic knowledge base through Markdown syntax, powerful web capture technology, and borderless synchronization, ensuring you truly own your data.

Key Features
1. Markdown First: Pure Writing and Recording
Memio adheres to a "Markdown-First" philosophy, providing users with a clean, efficient, and standardized way to record.
- Immersive Writing: Supports standard Markdown syntax with real-time preview, allowing you to record inspiration, reading notes, or meeting minutes without being distracted by formatting.
- Structured Management: Easily build logically rigorous long-form articles using headers, lists, quotes, and other syntax.
- Worry-Free Export: Notes can be exported at any time to Markdown, HTML, or PDF formats, ensuring your content is perfectly restored on any platform.

2. Powerful Web Capture (Read-it-Later)
Found a great article but don't have time to finish it? Memio offers a "Read-it-Later" feature far more powerful than traditional bookmarks.
- One-Click Clipping: Simply enter a URL or paste text, and Memio automatically extracts the body of the webpage, removes ads and clutter, and converts it into a clean, readable Markdown note.
-Offline Storage: Captured content is saved permanently on your device. Even if the original webpage is deleted, your knowledge reserve remains safe.

3. RSS Subscription Integration: Proactive Knowledge Acquisition
No more switching between multiple apps to check for updates.
- Unified Reading: Built-in RSS aggregation allows you to subscribe to your favorite blogs, news sources, or columns.
- Auto-to-Note: RSS updates can be directly converted into notes, making it convenient for you to annotate, excerpt, and categorize them at any time.

4. Custom Scripts: Capture Everything
For websites without open APIs or with complex structures, Memio provides unique "black tech."
- JS Extension Support: Developers or advanced users can write simple JavaScript scripts to accurately extract specific information from any webpage.
-Open Community: Access the Memio extension library to download and use capture plugins maintained by the community, greatly expanding your information boundaries.

5. Flexible Sync: Your Data Belongs to You
Memio understands the importance of data privacy and refuses to lock users into a single platform.

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I'm the creator of Memio (https://www.memio.site). I'm excited to share my project with you all.

The Problem:
I've always struggled with information overload. My knowledge is scattered across different platforms: articles I want to read later, notes, RSS feeds, and even AI chat logs. I wanted a central hub to connect and manage all this content, turning it into a personal, readable knowledge base.

The Solution:
That's why I built Memio. It's an Android app designed to capture and organize information from various sources and sync it to your private knowledge library. The core idea is to convert everything into clean, readable notes.

Key Features:
- Versatile Inputs: You can create notes from almost anywhere, including web articles, OCR, AI chats, and RSS feeds.
- Custom Extensions: This is a feature I'm particularly proud of. You can write simple JavaScript files to parse content from almost any website. We have an open-source repository for extensions (github.com/memio-app/memio-extensions) and documentation (www.memio.site/docs) to get you started.
- Organization & Export: Organize notes with tags, group them into "books," and sync your data to local files, WebDAV, and Notion. You can export notes to Markdown, HTML, or PDF.

Tech Stack:
- Android App: Native Kotlin
- Extension System: TypeScript compiled to JS
- Sync: WebDAV, Notion, Local Files

The app is currently in open testing on Google Play. I would love to get your feedback, especially on the extension …
